name: recent-items-popover
title: Recent items popover
description: A Recent button that lists what you opened lately, grouped by day, with pinning and a Clear history that offers Undo instead of asking, for apps where people jump around.
docs: Pass items ({ id, title, kind, href, openedAt, pinned }) in any order; the panel groups them under Pinned, Today, Yesterday and Earlier and orders each group newest first. kind picks the icon and the word under the title (project, document, record, board, folder, file, sheet and image are known, labels.kinds adds more). Pass now and timeZone so the headings and the times ('12 min. ago') are the same in server HTML and in the browser, with locale for the words; without now the browser's clock is read once the page is live. max is how many unpinned items are listed (default 8). Rows are links, or buttons without an href: onOpen(item, event) receives the event so a client-side router can preventDefault, and the popover closes. The list has one tab stop, the arrow keys, Home and End move between rows, Enter opens one and P calls onPin(item, pinned); a pin button on each row does the same for a pointer, and focus follows the item to its new group. onClear shows Clear history: the rows disappear and an Undo bar runs for undoMs (6 seconds), and only when Undo goes unused is onClear(clearedItems) called, which is the moment to delete them and to remove them from items; pinned items are kept, and closing the popover ends the wait. With nothing to show the panel explains that recent items appear after opening something. RecentItemsPanel is the inside on its own, trigger replaces the button, open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the popover, and labels translates every word.
